title: Amplitude definition
text: The amplitude is the distance between the midline and the maximum value.

title: Compute amplitude
text: The amplitude is $$2-\frac{1}{2}=\frac{4}{2}-\frac{1}{2}=\frac{3}{2}$$. \n We could also compute by looking at the maximum minus the minimum and dividing by 2: \n $$\frac{2-\left(-1\right)}{2}=\frac{3}{2}$$
